faq_heading: White Rock realtor: your questions answered

faq.q: Who is a top realtor in White Rock?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, is #1 in South Surrey & White Rock by FVREB Medallion Club points (2025 & 2026 YTD) and in the Top 1% of all REALTORS® in the Fraser Valley, with 10 straight years in the FVREB Medallion Club and 94 Google reviews.

faq.q: Does Jared Gibbons sell condos in White Rock?
faq.a: Yes. Condos are more than two thirds of White Rock sales. Jared has sold in Allure, Beachborough, Belaire, Miramar Village, The Arcadian, The Heritage, The Pauline, Victoria Terrace and Windermere, and reviews the strata minutes, depreciation report and bylaws on every condo.

faq.q: Is White Rock part of Surrey?
faq.a: No. The City of White Rock is a separate municipality with its own council, zoning bylaw and property tax. It is surrounded by South Surrey and shares Surrey Schools (School District 36).

faq.q: What do homes in White Rock sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to October 2026 the median detached house in White Rock sold for $1,565,000 and the median condo for $542,000 (Paragon MLS® data). Prices vary a lot by view, building and distance from the beach.

faq.q: How do I find out what my White Rock home is worth?
faq.a: Send the address through the home evaluation form or call or text 604-928-1361. Jared looks at the closest recent sales to your home, not a city average, and replies the same day with a price range.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
